text:
🇺🇲 Each year on Veterans Day, we recognize the countless sacrifices made by the brave men and women who defended the country we love and call home. As the daughter and granddaughter of Army, Navy, and Air Force Veterans, I’ve seen firsthand the dedication and sacrifice of our servicemembers and their families. It has been a distinct privilege to fight for the over 50,000 veterans here in Maryland’s Third District on the House Armed Services Committee and in Congress.

Even as a freshman member of the minority, I’ve worked with colleagues on both sides of the aisle to deliver for our veterans. Here’s what we’ve accomplished so far:

✔️ Just last week, I reconvened our third Veterans Advisory Council. Their wisdom and counsel  has already resulted in us working to expand veterans’ access to care at Walter Reed and introducing legislation to increase alternative treatment therapies for veterans living with PTSD and TBI.

✔️ Following the tragic suicides at Fort Meade, I’ve fought to remedy on-base mental health services, change the reporting requirements at the DoD, and address delays with the transfer of mental health licenses. 

✔️ After House Democrats secured the 218th signature required to bring the much-needed Major Richard Star Act to the Floor, we’ll finally vote on that bill this week. I plan on very proudly voting Yes. 

But there is much work ahead of us: Congress must act swiftly and decisively in January to support veterans, active-duty servicemembers, and military families. 

Finally, if you or a veteran you know needs assistance with the VA or any other federal agency, please don’t hesitate to reach out to my office at (410) 832-8890. In less than two years, my team has helped 154 veterans and their families navigate the VA – and we would be happy to help you or a loved one any time.

To all of our veterans: thank you for your service and sacrifice for our country.
